round1Findings.title: manifestNameOf not exported from the SDK barrel
round1Findings.verification: index.ts and dist/index.js/index.d.ts both export manifestNameOf; `import { manifestNameOf } from "@ezcorp/factory-sdk"` now resolves and runs.
